# atlassian_organization_workspaces (Data Source)

Searches all pages of an Atlassian organization and returns every matching workspace. A workspace is a single app instance, and its ID is the resource ARI that role assignments refer to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_organization_workspaces" "example" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  search          = "your-site-name"
}

output "confluence_resource_ari" {
  value = one([for workspace in data.atlassian_organization_workspaces.example.workspaces : workspace.id if workspace.type_key == "confluence"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.

### Optional

- `search` (String) Free-text search matching part of a workspace name or URL.

### Read-Only

- `workspaces` (Attributes Set) All workspaces matching the configured filters. The set is empty when no workspaces match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Resource ARI of the workspace, such as <samp>ari:<span>cloud</span>:confluence::site/&lt;site-id&gt;</samp>.
- `name` (String) Workspace name.
- `status` (String) Workspace status: online, offline, or deprecated.
- `type` (String) Display name of the app. Use type_key for comparisons.
- `type_key` (String) Machine-readable app key, such as confluence or jira-software.
